caption:
Strawberry Chia Pudding 
breakfast | low calorie | high in fibre, omega 3, antioxidents 

Nutrition:
C: 21 | F: 13 | P: 8
Calories: 221 per serve 
Serves 2

Ingredients
1/4 cup chia seeds
1 cup milk
1 tsp monkfruit / sugar / honey / maple syrup
1 tbsp yogurt
200 grams strawberries

Method: 
chia seed pudding : combine chia + milk + monkfruit + yogurt and store in the fridge overnight 
chop up your strawberries and layer with the pudding 
this recipe makes 2 portions and is convinient for meal prep 

this is a very lazy breakfast, if you want to be fancier, you can blend up some strawberries and mix it with the chia mix and leave overnight :)
